examples.english: It will take a little time - is that okay? Can you wait?

notes:
{少|すこ}し means "a little" or "a small amount," usable as both adverb and noun.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Adverb: {少|すこ}し⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ (please wait a little)
- With ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {少|すこ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (a little time)
- ⟦{少|すこ}しずつ→少しずつ：20047_sukoshizutsu⟧: little by little, gradually
- {少|すこ}し⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not at all, not in the least
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{少|すこ}し: a little more

REGISTER:
More formal/polite than ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧. Use {少|すこ}し in formal writing and polite speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧: a little (casual, also used as "excuse me")
- ⟦{少々|しょうしょう}→少々：03232_shoushou⟧: a little (very formal, often service industry)
- ⟦{多少|たしょう}→多少：01647_tashou⟧: somewhat, more or less
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧: a lot, many
